Use case: identity-preserve. This is NOT character redesign. The ONE attached image is the SOLE source of character identity, costume and style. Reproduce the exact same DeepSeek whale maid girl: 2.5 to 3 heads tall chibi, same rounded face and blue large eye shape/placement, indigo-blue long voluminous curls with vivid cyan ends, the same blue oval halo/loop above her head, white lace headband, two blue bows and white fin decorations. Copy the reference maid dress structure exactly: dark navy and white, the same collar/chest bow details, long sleeves and cuff details, same apron and small blue whale emblem, same skirt layers and lace, same pale legs/tights and navy shoes, same bright blue curved whale tail. Do not add or remove costume panels, jewelry, lace, buttons or accessories. Preserve hair volume/curl structure, body proportions and limb lengths. Fine clean anime line art, soft cel shading and layered hair highlights matching the reference. The blurred text and pale background in the reference are NOT part of the character: omit them.
Real transparent alpha background; no floor, shadow, scenery, text, numbers, watermarks, added logos or props. Keep the existing whale emblem. Fixed camera, consistent scale and head size, every girl fully contained in her cell. Each full-body character centered horizontally; halo top at 18% of each cell height, shoe soles at 85%; character height approximately 67%, with at least 10% clear safe margins around every extremity. No camera angle/zoom changes between keys. Physically plausible joints, exactly two arms and two legs, no floating body parts, no duplicated faces, no cloth clipping. Changes allowed ONLY in pose, expression and gentle hair/skirt/tail inertia. Do not make her older, taller, differently dressed or change her face.

Draw EXACTLY SIX successive whole-body key poses in a 3-column by 2-row grid, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. This is one continuous action by ONE identical girl, not six character variants. Every cell uses identical head size, hairstyle and outfit and fixed camera. Poses1 and6 must be the exact same neutral standing pose as the attached reference. All feet stay at the same baseline; no root translation. ACTION: 0–2s: smile, place both hands on sides of skirt. 2–5s: gently lift skirt sides only a little, bend both knees slightly, bow torso and lower head in a polite maid curtsy. 5–7s: hold briefly, rise gradually. 7–10s: release skirt, hands relaxed, gentle smile back to reference stand. SIX successive drawings: 1 neutral reference stand; 2 both hands touching skirt sides, upright; 3 shallow curtsy, hands lifting skirt slightly, knees slightly bent and head bowed; 4 deepest polite curtsy but no exaggerated squat; 5 rising gracefully, hands still near skirt; 6 exact neutral reference stand. Dress must not change shape/construction or expose new garments.
Never add any colored glow, gradient, mist, shadow or vignette. Truly transparent pixels everywhere outside each character's outline, opaque clean character colors. Keep all six separate, whole and safely inside their cells.
